text:
Stop texting girls who won't meet up. It's costing you everything.

Your attention is money. Every minute texting a girl with no end date is attention you're burning.

No timeline. No forward motion. Just feeding her ego while you starve.

Which threads are dead? Delete them today.

Take that energy and build yourself. Become worth meeting.

Attention is currency. You're broke.
